statement: A Nevada corporation files its initial list of officers and directors at the time its articles of incorporation are filed, and annually thereafter on or before the last day of the month in which its incorporation anniversary falls (NRS 78.150(1)-(2)), each list carrying a declaration under penalty of perjury; the state business license runs alongside it, with a $500 fee for corporations organized under NRS chapters 78/78A/78B (and qualifying foreign corporations) at application and on each renewal (NRS 76.100, 76.130), $200 for other entity types.
caveat: The annual-list filing fee itself scales with authorized stock and is set by separate fee statutes not carded here; defaulting corporations face revocation and reinstatement costs (NRS 78.170-78.185). nvsos.gov bot-walls non-browser clients, so verification ran against the Legislature's statute text — check the live SilverFlume portal for current totals before paying.
